impact: A safe Rust caller can construct an event with a non-null unreadable payload pointer and invoke either safe conversion API using an accessibility or text event. The adapter dereferences the pointer without a caller-visible safety precondition, causing undefined behavior.
impact_or_question: A safe Rust caller can construct an event with a non-null unreadable payload pointer and invoke either safe conversion API using an accessibility or text event. The adapter dereferences the pointer without a caller-visible safety precondition, causing undefined behavior.
next_action: Harden the trust boundary with a documented unsafe precondition or validated owned/borrowed payload type and add a focused safety regression test. API/behavior repair is deferred because this audit authorizes comments only.
source_label: // BUG: [CR-R02-public_ui_state-0001] 安全输入携带公开原始 payload 指针；可访问性/文本分支直接调用 unsafe checked_slice，不可读地址会导致未定义行为。
structured_evidence: zircon_runtime_interface/src/runtime_api/session/events.rs:12-26 exposes ZrRuntimeEventV1.payload as a public ZrByteSlice; zircon_runtime_interface/src/buffer.rs:113-116 exposes raw pointer and length.
zircon_runtime_interface/src/buffer.rs:144 documents checked_slice as unsafe: it checks carrier shape/length, while readability and returned-reference lifetime remain caller preconditions.

zircon_runtime_interface/src/ui/window/runtime_event_adapter.rs:167-241 safely accepts the publicly constructible event; accessibility_event and payload_bytes call checked_slice inside unsafe blocks (current lines 558-565 and 601-608). The batch uses the same safe converter.
